function: No learned component: Ford-Fulkerson max-flow routing (p. 8) plus DM-PSO, a particle swarm heuristic whose diffusion step only adds Gaussian noise to crowded particles (p. 10).
notes: Excluded as no_learning. The UAV-swarm collaborative beamforming network is optimized in two stages: Ford-Fulkerson max flow for routing (p. 8, Algorithm 1) and DM-PSO for UAV excitation weights and positions (p. 10). The 'diffusion model' is only the forward noising step x = sqrt(alpha) x + sqrt(1-alpha) z applied to crowded particles (p. 10, Eq. 25); no network is trained. The paper calls it 'a heuristic algorithm' (p. 10) and rejects DRL for its training time (p. 10). Baselines are routing protocols and metaheuristics (DE, GA, ABC, SSA, PSO), pp. 12-13. PDF is arXiv:2501.05742v1, a preprint; its title was not checked against the DOI record.
